about: A teaser of the Wang Bi lesson (series/explainers/wangbi-lesson.json) for Instagram, whose Reels stop at 3 min (the lesson is 3:48). The user, 2026-09-28: 'Lets cut a teaser and let me see it'. The pages are the lesson's own, unchanged: who Wang Bi was, what a hexagram is, yin and yang, the master and how to find it, then 7 The Army as the question and its answer. Rendered by the same Lesson composition, so the sounds and end card follow the lesson.
readoutsNote: 22's readout as the lesson teaches it (master line 5), pinned 2026-09-27 when the short's own readout moved to line 6, plain white

22.finding: THE SOFT COMES TO ADORN THE STRONG.

sources.places: Zhouyi lüeli 辯位: 初上无陰陽定位; 夫位者，列貴賤之地，待才用之宅也
sources.master: Wang Bi, Zhouyi lüeli 明彖: the centre line first, and the few ruling the many (夫少者多之所貴也); sometimes no line rules and the trigrams do. The lists of hexagrams and 至少者為至多之所主 printed with it are Xing Shu's Tang notes, not Wang Bi's.
sources.answering: Zhouyi lüeli 明卦適變通爻: 應者，同志之象也 (answering lines share an aim); the OCR here lost the start, so cite a printed edition
sources.22: Wang Bi on 22 line 5: 處得尊位，為飾之主
sources.7: Wang Bi on 7 line 2: 為師之主; on 7 line 5: 柔非軍帥……必以授也
sources.dates: He Shao, 王弼傳 (Biography of Wang Bi)
sources.few rule the many: 明彖: 夫眾不能治眾，治眾者至寡者也 (the many can't govern the many; the fewest govern them); 一卦五陽而一陰，則一陰為之主矣 (five yang and one yin: the yin is master)
sources.centres: 明彖: 非其中爻，莫之備矣 (without the centre line, none is complete), Wang Bi adapting the Great Commentary (繫辭下)
sources.why L2 is marked: Tuan 柔來而文剛 (the soft comes to adorn the strong); Wang Bi: 坤之上六來居二位 (Kun's top yin comes to sit in the second place)
sources.22 lesson: Wang Bi on 22 line 5: 用莫過儉 (in spending, nothing beats thrift)
sources.7 reveal: Wang Bi on 7 line 2: 以剛居中，而應於上 (firm, in the centre, answered from above); 為師之主 (master of the army)
sources.10 and 16 drawing: Wang Bi: 三為履主 (line three, master of Treading); on 16 line 4: 獨體陽爻，眾陰所從 (the one yang line, which all the yin follow)
sources.order: Checking for a lone line first, then the centres, is our working order, not Wang Bi's; 'most often L5' is our count of the masters in his notes (scripts/wangbi.mjs). Never credit either to him on screen.

style: The header reads 'SIX LINES // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout. Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.
holds: one-glance pages (DEFINE: TRIGRAM, DEFINE: CENTRE, IN 22, LINES 1 AND 6) about 4 s; others by reading time

music.why: calm, 90 bpm, long enough (197 s); pick14 (22's track) is 146 s. Under the whole video since 2026-10-01 (the user, review board: lesson 'for lessons this long we may need some background music'; teaser 'consider adding appropriate background music'), at the timeline's mix, machine sounds pulled back.

show_keys: hex: hexagram number, or 'pair' (one solid, one broken), or small: [a, b] (two small hexagrams); draw: plot draws in bottom line first; log: columns shown (yy, place, centre; place never on L1/L6); lit: lines at full strength, the rest dim; amber: lines amber with ◄; links: answering pairs drawn on the left; brackets, names: trigram brackets and UPPER/LOWER names; ranks: a bracket over L2–L5; big: large text in the drawing area; lesson: white text typed in the drawing area; full: [{n, after}] cut to hexagram n's complete readout after answer line `after`, 5 s; then: [{after: seconds after the answer, ...changes}]
